decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s core pipeline-component business, it likely has low incremental carrying cost and still retains option value because only limited market learning is available after launch.

The bracket broadens the range for existing infrastructure customers and is inexpensive to leave in the portfolio, but as a relatively standard item it has a somewhat higher risk of later withdrawal if demand proves weak.

This support bracket fits the firm’s fabrication capabilities and customer base well, so with uncertainty still unresolved and no clear negative signal yet, keeping it on the market is the better real-options choice.
